title: Horizontal pod autoscaling (HPA) by CPU, memory and external metrics

videos.script: Lesson 21 measured the shop under load and chose a size by hand. That size was right for one afternoon. Traffic is not one afternoon. {{hand}} The HorizontalPodAutoscaler makes the choice again every fifteen seconds. It reads how busy the pods are, compares that with a target, and changes the number of replicas. {{loop}} Its whole logic is one line of arithmetic, and you will be able to predict what it does before it does it. {{arithmetic}} You will put the shop under four clients at once, watch it grow from one copy to six, stop the load, and watch it shrink back. {{plan}}
